subject: LAB-012
check: Manual swatch replay through PointInspectSession and the Mac host SQLite backend
steps: labr <ticket worktree> xcodebuild -project AppleNativeLab.xcodeproj -scheme LabMac-Core -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -only-testing:LabMacTests/PointInspectHostTests -only-testing:LabMacTests/PointInspectQualificationHostTests test -quiet
On a fresh SQLite store in the sandboxed Mac host, replayFixture, set Title and Note, useFields, apply, inspect item, resetDemo, compare saved item
Read xcresult summary: 3 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped

outcome.detail: The bundled swatch decoded as PNG. The backend typed-record test committed as app UI. The complete session replay showed Fixture replay and Manual fields (not a model), added no receipt during Use These Fields, added collection and item receipts on Apply, and stored one user item containing the swatch hash. Reset Demo preserved the item exactly.

limitations: Fixture execution inside the sandboxed Mac app on macOS 27.0 (26A425), not physical camera or live-model evidence.
No visible window control, open panel, pointer, keyboard, or accessibility tree was driven. Session methods were called directly.
Focused run used the Mac scheme default destination. Its earlier explicit-destination invocation was stopped while queued and ran no test.
The source revision identifies the mirrored checkout; the focused command did not set LAB_SOURCE_REVISION for the app Info.plist.
No iPhone, iPad, camera, system visual search, live image description, or manual assistive-technology run.
